title: The fox and the crow.
lines: In a big forest there's a tall tree.
High in the tree sits a crow.
She's holding it in her beak.
I'm going to eat this very slowly.
A fox is walking under the tree.
A red fox with a bushy tail.
With a big piece of cheese in her beak.
The fox can't climb the tree.
He isn't very good at climbing.
How can I get that cheese?
says the fox in a very sweet little voice.
Because she has the cheese in her beak.
How lovely you look today, says the fox.
Your feathers shine in the sun.
She fluffs up her feathers a little.
And what beautiful eyes you have, the fox goes on.
I've heard, says the fox, that you can sing beautifully too.
I think you must be the queen of all birds.
If you sing as beautifully as you look.
The crow is so pleased with all those sweet words.
She wants to show how beautifully she can sing.
Beware of someone who only gives you compliments.
Maybe they want something from you.
Next time she won't just listen to pretty words.
